hints.title: Modulo Target Pairs
hints.text: For each possible target remainder target in [0..k - 1], the sequence of remainders must alternate between r and (target - r) % k.

hints.title: State Array
hints.text: Maintain dp[r][target] representing the longest valid subsequence ending with remainder r when the pairwise sum remainder is target.

hints.title: Transitions per Element
hints.text: For an element with remainder r, update dp[r][target] = dp[(target - r) % k][target] + 1 for each target from 0 to k - 1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Transitions run in O(k) per array element.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all possible subsequences takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(k^2) matrix stores active remainder transitions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the two-element periodic cycle for each target remainder sum.
